release_scope: Only code, protocol, documentation, references and third-party license; no research results.
adaptations: Public input/output uses the main lalf molecule_id,smiles,s1,est,f,ratio schema; optional socme/t_state preserved.
Detailed paper prompts/history selection retained; main Thresholds and main parser EST definition shared.
First-front paper ranking retained, distinct from production successive Pareto layers and LLM score ranking.
Dataset paths, feature caches, API endpoint/cache and historical result/analysis dependencies removed.
PCA rebuilt from structures only, seed 0, dimension min(128,n_structures,2048); external historical cache not distributed.
Standalone runner has explicit query boundary, unique-budget guards and overwrite refusal; historical resume/cache protocol not reconstructed.
Random method uses one whole-budget draw sliced into batches, matching retained figure protocol rather than the later round-wise random variant.
GCN validation split retains a training row for small libraries; manuscript 20-label start unchanged.
MOBO retains model/prescreen/qPOTS kernels; qLogNParEGO adapter has explicit pending points and propagates acquisition failures.
MOBO seeds isolated per round for portable invocation; historical global random-state sequence and exact trajectories not claimed.
Graph-GA v0.0 callable operator code is preserved; upstream __main__ demonstrations removed. Published and upstream SHA256 hashes recorded separately; original MIT license retained.
Full-dataset label evaluation isolated as optional post-hoc metrics; no plots or experiment outputs distributed.
Excluded full_llm/llm_beta0 and nonretained qLogNEHVI do not appear in the method registry.
reproducibility_limit: Portable source refactoring, not byte-for-byte replay of historical L-ALF or baseline trajectories; labeled library and exact historical backend/cache are not distributed.
